success_metrics.label: Sickle-claw contact success
success_metrics.definition: A left or right sickle-claw geom contacts the prey geom while the strike reward is enabled.

deliverable_metrics.label: Stance quality (stance_quality/v2)
deliverable_metrics.definition: The stance checkpoint clears the stance_quality/v2 gate, judged post-stage on the handoff pair: the one-sided 95% lower bound on the share of the 40 certification-panel episodes that are clean on floor truth (horizon reached, no hop or impact in the settle window, both feet down and loaded, both toes and the metatarsal head of each foot loaded, no actuator held at its limit) meets the configured bound, with the reward rails as collapse floors only. The clean count and its bound are recorded in gate_verdict.json but not exported to summary.json until a later phase (decision D-A9, deferred by D-B15), so the catalog names them with no value.

deliverable_metrics.label: Gated forward velocity (reward_and_length/v1)
deliverable_metrics.definition: The locomotion checkpoint clears the reward_and_length/v1 gate: mean forward velocity at or above the stage's configured minimum, with its reward and episode-length floors, over the required consecutive evaluations.

deliverable_metrics.label: Sickle-claw contact success
deliverable_metrics.definition: A left or right sickle-claw geom contacts the prey geom while the strike reward is enabled.

success_metrics.label: Head-contact bite proxy
success_metrics.definition: The head-bite geom contacts the prey geom while the bite reward is enabled; the model has no articulated jaw.

deliverable_metrics.label: Stance quality at six headings (stance_quality_heading/v1)
deliverable_metrics.definition: The stance checkpoint clears the stance_quality_heading/v1 gate (the six-heading certificate, decision D-D32), judged post-stage on the handoff pair: the 40 certification-panel seeds are rolled with the whole scene turned -90, -45, 0, 45, 90 and 180 degrees; at every heading the stance_quality/v2 decision on floor truth (horizon reached, no hop or impact in the settle window, both feet down and loaded, flat pads, no actuator held at its limit) passes against the statue rolled at that heading, and the one-sided 95% lower bound on the share of seeds clean at every heading meets the configured bound, with the reward rails as collapse floors only. The clean-seed count and its bound are recorded in gate_verdict.json but not exported to summary.json until a later phase (decision D-A9, deferred by D-B15), so the catalog names them with no value.

deliverable_metrics.label: Recovery under pushes (recovery_quality/v1)
deliverable_metrics.definition: The recovery checkpoint clears the recovery_quality/v1 gate, judged post-stage against the run's frozen gate_resolution.json: recovery-success LCB95 and the paired delta against each required frozen null meet the frozen thresholds, with re-entry inside the configured step budget and dwell. The statistics are not exported to summary.json until a later phase (decision D-A9, deferred by D-B15).

deliverable_metrics.label: Gated forward velocity (reward_and_length/v1)
deliverable_metrics.definition: The locomotion checkpoint clears the reward_and_length/v1 gate: mean forward velocity at or above the stage's configured minimum, with its reward and episode-length floors, over the required consecutive evaluations.

deliverable_metrics.label: Head-contact bite success (task_success/v1)
deliverable_metrics.definition: The hunt checkpoint clears the task_success/v1 gate: the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound on per-episode head-contact bite success (the head-bite geom contacts the prey geom while the bite reward is enabled; the model has no articulated jaw) over the selected checkpoint's evaluation_selected.csv at the stage's declared min_eval_episodes, hash-bound to that checkpoint, meets the configured min_success_lcb bar (provisional until the first Phase-B pilot re-freezes it; decision D-B2), with the reward rail as a collapse floor only. The bound is exported to summary.json as selected_model_success_lcb beside the raw selected-checkpoint rate.

success_metrics.definition: The head-tip site comes within the configured food-reach threshold of the food target while the food-reach bonus is enabled.

deliverable_metrics.label: Reward-gated stance (reward_and_length/v1)
deliverable_metrics.definition: The stance checkpoint clears the reward_and_length/v1 gate: mean evaluation reward at or above the statue-derived collapse rail and a near-full-horizon mean episode length over the required consecutive evaluations. The zero-action statue clears this gate, so stand is labelled by its gate kind here rather than claimed as certified stance quality; stance_quality/v1 waits on shin instrumentation (a kneeling pose currently reads identically to airborne) (plan §4.8).
